messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up — onsite for Liam Chen (SWE candidate) next Fri 10:00am (hybrid). He needs early building access ~8:30am to pick up visa docs, plus a Windows test machine with GPU and a USB-C dock. Also request: ergonomic keyboard and height-adjustable chair in the interview room. Need halal lunch + parking validation. Can we confirm? cc @Devon_R @IT Support @Facilities
Devon R.: Thanks Aisha. Do we have Liam's full legal name and DOB for badge request?
Aisha Khan: Full name: Liam Chen. DOB: 1994-06-12. Visa pickup scheduled 09:15 that morning.
IT Support: We can provision a loaner Windows laptop with RTX-class GPU and dock. Will image with Win11 + VSCode + Docker. Any other apps?
Aisha Khan: No extra licensed apps. Browser + ssh keys will be fine. Please tag the device with "candidate-1897" so Facilities can identify.
IT Support: Copy. We'll image tonight and mark for delivery. ETA to room B5 by 08:05.
Facilities: We can reserve room B5 and an adjustable desk + ergonomic chair. Parking spot P2 reserved under "Candidate — Liam Chen". Security escort available at 08:30. Who will meet him?
Aisha Khan: I will meet him at the lobby. I'll share my mobile in the invite.
Devon R.: I'll handle taxi reimbursement. Policy: up to $120 for candidate travel if not using company travel. Ask Liam to keep receipt.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: candidate meal cap is $40/person. Please submit receipts with the tag "candidate-meal" for automatic routing.
Aisha Khan: Noted. For catering: proposing halal boxed lunches from Salaam Kitchen (chicken + veg option). Any allergy constraints?
Devon R.: Please include nut-free option as a precaution.
Facilities: Catering ordered: 3 options (chicken halal, veg halal, nut-free clearly labeled). Delivery at 11:45 to B5.
Aisha Khan: Remote panelist Marta will join at 1pm PT. Can AV/IT confirm Teams link + mic/cam test 15m before? Her email is marta@redwood.com.
IT Support: Teams meeting created, will share link in the invites. AV tech will test room A/V at 12:45.
Facilities: Temporary door code for B5: 4721 (expires EOD). Security will badge Liam through if needed.
Aisha Khan: Thanks. Can Facilities leave the laptop unlocked and labeled for the interviewer?
IT Support: Laptop will be labeled and left at desk, password placeholder set to "RedwoodGuest123" — please change for candidate privacy if needed.
Devon R.: I'll confirm expense workflow with Liam. He can submit taxi and any incidental parking fees.
Aisha Khan: One more ask — can we provide a small welcome packet with visitor wifi creds and basic campus map?
Facilities: Yes, welcome packet will be at the desk with visitor wifi: RedwoodGuest / welcome2025.
People Ops Bot: Calendar invites sent to panelists and candidate. Reminder set for 24h and 1h before start.
Aisha Khan: Awesome — thank you everyone. I'll update calendar with my mobile and arrival instructions, and DM any last-minute changes. :thumbsup:
Devon R.: All set from my side.
IT Support: Imaging complete. Laptop placed in B5 at 08:05.
Facilities: Parking validated and catering confirmed.
Aisha Khan: Perfect, closing out. I'll post a final checklist in this thread day-before.
